Placemaker.Biome.lawn.Tooltip: The park as its style plants it: mown grass, its own trees, shrub borders and benches.
Placemaker.Biome.meadow.Tooltip: Long unmown grass with wild flowers, a few old solitary trees and scrub at its edges.
Placemaker.Biome.flowers.Tooltip: A field of wild flowers: yellow, purple, red and blue drifts, flowering shrubs.
Placemaker.Biome.mulch.Tooltip: Planted beds on bark mulch: dense shrubs and a few small trees, mostly by the paths.
Placemaker.Biome.glade.Tooltip: Open woodland: groups of trees with grassy clearings between, a fallen log here and there.
Placemaker.Biome.forest.Tooltip: A closed wood: dense canopy, undergrowth, forest floor, fallen logs, scrub at its edge.
Placemaker.Biome.rocky.Tooltip: Raised, broken ground with outcrops of big boulders, loose rocks and scree, a few pines.
Placemaker.Biome.heath.Tooltip: Sandy ground with low heather scrub, a few pines and birches, small stones.
Placemaker.Biome.wetland.Tooltip: Marsh in the low ground: shallow hollows, mud and standing water, reeds, alders and willows.
Placemaker.Biome.water.Tooltip: Natural ponds in the low ground with banked shores, reeds and wet trees. Permanent: changes the terrain.
Placemaker.Biome.scale.Tooltip: Low: many small patches mixed together. High: a few big areas, each with its own character.
Placemaker.Biome.fields.Tooltip: The farm's own fields: crops, hay meadows and pastures with their hedges, gates and tracks.
Placemaker.Biome.orchard.Tooltip: Fruit trees in straight rows with mown grass alleys, on the warm slopes and the flats.
Placemaker.Biome.pasture.Tooltip: Tussocky grass with gorse and thorn scrub, stones and sheep tracks, on the steep and poor ground.
